summary: The National Conference of State Legislatures (NCSL) supports the Universal Service Fund’s E-Rate program and its core mission of ensuring universal, affordable access to broadband internet in schools and libraries. NCSL believes that decisions on screen time limits within the school context, especially for instructional purposes, are best left to states and local schools, consistent with longstanding principles in the state-federal relationship in education.
